shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with an adjacent unshaded interior cutout or excluded part. On the left, use the light-blue ring between the two concentric circles. On the right, use the outer gray band between the two largest circles.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It is the part of the disk of radius 7 outside the disk of radius 5. Right image: It identifies the annulus inside the largest disk but outside the disk immediately within it.
Rationales: The shade identifies the remainder after leaving designated pieces out of an enclosing geometric area. Those pieces must be removed from the area computation in each panel.
